newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares lose steam in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares lose steam in moderate trade.

text.p: The Saudi stock market ended the week to Thursday lower in moderate trade with buying interest focused on service sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisers (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended the week lower at at 163.12 points down from 165.68 points a week earlier.
Of the 58 companies traded, 13 rose, 42 fell and three were unchanged.
Service sector stocks continued to dominate, accounting for 52 percent of volume which BFA put at about 8.6 million shares worth 1.05 billion riyals ($280 million).

Among gainers in the week were National Gypsum which gained 8.9 percent to 330 riyals from 303 riyals a week earlier, al-Bank al-Saudi al-Fransi which ended 4.3 percent higher at 240 riyals from a previous 230 riyals and Saudi Fisheries which closed 3.5 percent higher at 207 riyals from 200 riyals.
Al-Azizia Panda lost 9.7 percent to 130 riyals from 144 a week earlier and Beshah Agriculture was 6.8 percent lower at 41 riyals froim 44 riyals. ($1=3.75 riyals)
